intentionalDifferences: Domain commands refuse with exit 3, no document, store, network or process work.
Help pages are printed as drafted; clap parses the arguments, and every usage error is printed in ob's one style (error:, then hint:).
Singleton options reject repeated assignments instead of silent last-write.
Stdin conflicts count only input sources, not literal dashes in descriptions or output paths.
Argument grammar is checked; document, value and policy validation await handlers.
